ownership.quote: Vultr has carved out a unique position as the only independent, globally available, full-stack cloud infrastructure platform

stage.quote: Vultr has completed a growth financing round at a $3.5 billion valuation. The investment, led by LuminArx Capital Management and AMD Ventures... Vultr, which was founded in 2014 by David Aninowsky and has been operating as a self-funded company for over a decade.
stage.note: Vultr was bootstrapped/self-funded for a decade (2014-2024); the December 2024 $333M growth financing from LuminArx Capital Management and AMD Ventures is its first disclosed priced external round, so it is labeled here as its first ('series-a'-equivalent) institutional round rather than true seed. Some trackers may still list it as bootstrapped given the single-round history.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sole disclosed external financing round (Dec 2024), per Vultr's own press release and WSJ coverage cited therein
total_funding_usd.quote: Read the coverage here. [links to WSJ: "Cloud AI Startup Vultr Raises $333 Million at $3.5 Billion Valuation"]

last_round.quote: Vultr has completed a growth financing round at a $3.5 billion valuation. The investment, led by LuminArx Capital Management and AMD Ventures, is set to fuel Vultr's global expansion in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure and cloud computing.

note: Founded 2014 by David Aninowsky; self-funded/bootstrapped for a decade before its first disclosed external financing (Dec 2024, $333M at a $3.5B valuation, led by LuminArx Capital Management and AMD Ventures). In 2025 Vultr also secured $329M in additional credit financing (debt, not equity) from banks including Bank of America, Citi, and Goldman Sachs, and is building a >$1B, 50MW AMD GPU data center in Ohio (online Q1 2026). CEO is J.J. Kardwell; founder David Aninowsky is Executive Chairman.
